scope: Extend Gate ADL spot repair to Bybit and Binance same-account USDT linear funding-rate environments
coverage: Bybit AdlTrade retains native identity even with a numeric orderLinkId
Binance adl_autoclose preserves PM and standard USD-M account scope
Binance cumulative fill watermark rejects duplicate, older and invalid updates, including zero native trade IDs
Repair is limited to the three supported same-exchange FundingArb pairs and excluded from Exec, COIN-M and other modes
Shared partial-fill, inventory cap and unresolved-order reservation lifecycle
Bybit spot market repair uses base quantity without enabling new borrowing
notes: No live orders were submitted in verification; no live Bybit or Binance ADL event was observed.
Binance uses a local repair adapter after factual native fill persistence, without emitting another account IPC event.
Repair and deduplication state is process-local; a restart during repair requires reconciling outstanding orders and actual exposure.
Historical ADL records are not automatically replayed into orders.
